content.title: How to watch Barcelona vs. Atletico Madrid in the U.S.: TV channel and streaming options for April 4
content.text: Barcelona visits Atletico Madrid in La Liga at Riyadh Air Metropolitano on Saturday, April 4. The two clubs will battle at 3 p.m. ET. Barcelona is currently first overall in the league, with 73 points. Atletico Madrid is fourth, with 57.How to watch FC Barcelona vs. Atletico Madrid in the U.S. Venue: Riyadh Air Metropolitano Time: 3 p.m. ET Streaming: ESPN+ (Sign in on ESPN with your Fubo account) TV: ESPN Deportes, ESPN+, Fubo TV FC Barcelona vs. Atletico Madrid odds Favorite Moneyline: Barcelona +114 Underdog Moneyline: Atletico Madrid +201 Total: 3.5 Total Over Odds: -108 Total Under Odds: -120 Odds provided by BetMGM.Injury reportsFC BarcelonaRaphinha: Out, Frenkie De Jong: Out, Andreas Christensen: OutAtletico MadridPablo Barrios Rivas: Doubtful, Jan Oblak: Doubtful, Johnny Cardoso: Out, Rodrigo Mendoza Martinez Moya: Doubtful, Marcos Llorente: OutStats to know Lamine Yamal is Barcelona’s leading scorer this year, with 14 goals in 25 games (third in league). Barcelona is first in the league in goal differential at +50. Alexander Sorloth is Atletico Madrid’s top scorer, with 10 goals (11th in league) in 28 games. Atletico Madrid’s goal differential (+21) is third in the league.
